name: Dissen am Teutoburger Wald (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Dissen am Teutoburger Wald (a yellow wheel on green under a crown).
history: The city flag carries the arms at the centre and its colours are red, white and red.

features.role: Dissen arms — yellow wheel on green
